Stationary points occur where f'(x) = 0 (critical points). Here’s how: 1) Differentiate y = f(x) to get f'(x). 2) Set f'(x) = 0 and solve for x. 3) Check if the point is a max/min by testing second derivative (f''(x)) or using intervals.
